Combined with a_{2n} monotonicity (a_0 through a_6 individually monotone), this closes the non-perturbative spectral action escape route with finality that admits no appeal. Cosmic-Web's insight (adopted by Einstein in Round 2): this SIMPLIFIES the predictive landscape. BCS wells are the ONLY features in an otherwise flat spectral action landscape -- one transition, one scale, one amplitude.
